name: minerva
description: R0 groundwork for the greenfield Minerva prototype.

scripts.secrets:scan: set -eu; ignored_tracked=$(git ls-files --cached --ignored --exclude-standard); test -z "$ignored_tracked" || { printf '%s\n' "$ignored_tracked" >&2; exit 1; }; gitleaks git --redact --no-banner --no-color; scan_root=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/minerva-secret-scan.XXXXXX"); trap 'rm -rf "$scan_root"' EXIT HUP INT TERM; mkdir -p "$scan_root/objects" "$scan_root/files"; GIT_INDEX_FILE="$scan_root/index" GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY="$scan_root/objects" git read-tree --empty; git ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard | GIT_INDEX_FILE="$scan_root/index" GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY="$scan_root/objects" git update-index --add --remove -z --stdin; GIT_INDEX_FILE="$scan_root/index" GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY="$scan_root/objects" git checkout-index --all --force --prefix="$scan_root/files/"; gitleaks dir "$scan_root/files" --redact --no-banner --no-color
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run secrets:scan && npm run roadmap:status
